children: HONG KONG, Sept. 8, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- ClubMed Lifestyle Group, a subsidiary of Fosun International Limited (656), has joined the World Travel & Tourism Council (WTTC) as a Global Member. The membership was announced by WTTC on August 28.

ClubMed Lifestyle Group operates premium all-inclusive resorts with Club Med as its core brand. It also expands its vacation offerings, which include Integrated Vacation Destinations and Cultural-Tourism Complexes through an asset-light model, as it continues to build diversified vacation lifestyles.

Based on 2025 turnover, Club Med, the core brand of ClubMed Lifestyle Group, is the world's largest all-inclusive resort brand. It currently operates 69 resorts across more than 40 countries and regions on six continents, serving over 1.5 million guests annually. The Group expects to operate approximately 85 resorts worldwide by 2030.

Since late 2025, ClubMed Lifestyle Group has signed new resort projects in China, Canada, Morocco, Brazil, the U.S. Virgin Islands, Indonesia and Italy, while accelerating expansion across the Alps, the Mediterranean and North African coasts, Northeast and Southeast Asia, the Americas and the Caribbean, and exploring the Middle East. In July, Club Med, the core brand of ClubMed Lifestyle Group, signed a strategic cooperation memorandum with Microsoft at its Paris headquarters. The signing ceremony was attended by Corinne De Bilbao, CEO of Microsoft France, and Xu Bingbin, Co-President of ClubMed Lifestyle Group. The partnership focuses on AI‑powered guest experiences, cloud‑native transformation and operational modernisation.

The WTTC membership, a mark of global industry recognition, and the Microsoft partnership, which enhances operational intelligence, are mutually reinforcing, providing solid support for ClubMed Lifestyle Group's path from 69 resorts towards its 2030 target of 85 resorts.
